status: Complete: all eight changes, reference comparisons, single measurements, shared-engine regression and repository audit pass

items.title: Stable linear expert routing buckets
items.implementation: Histogram, prefix offsets and one stable fill replace scanning every token/selection for every expert. Router selection and within-expert token/slot order are unchanged.
items.verification: Native F32/Q8 routing fixtures, watched/unwatched batched checkpoint equality and exact CPU capture.

items.title: Direct indexed expert inputs
items.implementation: Native F32-activation experts read selected rows through checked member indices. Dispatch uses indexed four/six-vector products and shares decoded physical rows across larger groups; small K-format groups can fuse decoding. Integer activations and panels keep their gathered path.
items.verification: Exact indexed-source matrices with shifted bounds, reordered/duplicate inputs, invalid indices, row tails and count 1..17; native expert integration.

items.title: GPU attention output convolution
items.implementation: Extend the existing gate/multiply/output sequence with causal three/four-tap convolution. The checkpoint uses four taps. Raw outputs return for finite checks; host history commits only after successful execution and remains covered by call rollback.
items.verification: Positive device execution for both tap counts and batches 1..17, CPU output/history comparisons, prefix partition/rewind/cancel cases and independent full-checkpoint GPU conformance.

items.title: GPU loop-control blending
items.implementation: Down/gain/forget projections and message blending use one existing native sequence. An optional Float64 controller shader evaluates range-reduced tanh then rounds to binary32, preserving ordinary shared shader modes. The existing Float64 rotation pipeline gates availability; unsupported devices use the original control path.
items.verification: 256 controller values match widened host tanh bit for bit; direct batched blend tests and full-checkpoint reference pass unchanged tolerances. The initial float32 tanh failure is preserved under before-accurate-controls.

items.title: Fused quantized batches through sixteen
items.implementation: Extend packed Q4_K/Q5_K/Q6_K groups through sixteen for matrices up to 256 columns; wide vectors use fused groups only through three, then share staged decoding. The first unrestricted trial regressed prefill and is preserved. Retain binary32 dequantization and the original four binary64 lanes and 2048-element folds. Larger batches keep the prior kernels.
items.verification: Exact format/shape/count matrices, extreme/signed/subnormal scales, shifted bounds, tails and all original checkpoint activation bytes.

items.title: Bounded physical quantization scale metadata
items.implementation: Session-owned immutable tables for CPU F32-activation adapter projections, keyed by physical layer/role and limited to 128 MiB. Tensor views borrow tables, mapped weights stay unchanged, reset retains them and Close frees them. Budget planning reserves table storage and pointer bookkeeping. Tables are prepared only for batches through sixteen, which have eligible consumers.
items.verification: Cached/uncached exact matrix products across all tested shapes/scales, real-checkpoint reset/reuse and memory/lifecycle cases. Expert weights and unsupported tensor layouts retain native decoding.

items.title: Adaptive expert chunk sizes
items.implementation: For Inkling, cap chunks at four rows for batches through 16, eight through 63 and sixteen thereafter; actual expert occupancy bounds each chunk. Dynamic existing job distribution and selection-slot reduction order are retained. Other architectures keep their original sixteen-row cap.
items.verification: Partition-size, expert grouping, native prefill/decode and exact-capture checks. This heuristic is bounded, not claimed to be globally optimal.

items.title: Cost-aware context-lookup verification
items.implementation: Explicit greedy Inkling context lookup records warmup-filtered round costs in the existing bounded cost arrays and combines them with acceptance by position. Three samples and a two-percent predicted gain are required to change the proposal cap; the requested maximum and existing low-acceptance/backoff rules remain. No default drafting enablement change.
items.verification: Pure chooser cases for faster/expensive lengths, missing/invalid evidence, hysteresis and caps; normal lookup generation equivalence and identical measured greedy output.
